Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

Various discounts can be applied for patients, such as user-wise limit discount and date-wise discount. If a billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. Additionally, to associate any discount profile with a patient's bill, select the details from the 'Reference' field and then click on the 'Apply' button. A discount will be automatically applied on the bill.
